senses.gloss:
Veṅkaṭeśa
------------------------------------------
The god of तिरुमल-तिरुपति is known by various names, of which these two are most common.
The hill on which the temple and the deity are situated was called Veṅgaḍa, a Tamil word, later Sanskritised to Veṅkaṭa. The lord of this hill came to be known as वेङ्कटेश or Veṅkaṭeśvara.
According to the local legends, when the sage भृगु who went to वैकुण्ठ (the abode of विष्णु) humiliated Lord विष्णु, लक्ष्मी (consort of विष्णु) got angry, descended to the earth and settled down at कोल्हापुर्. विष्णु too came down in search of her. Not finding her, he was roaming about in the forest atop this hill. When पद्मावती, daughter of the king Ākāśarāja, was rescued by him from a fierce elephant, she fell in love with him. (Padmāvatī was actually वेदवती reborn. She had performed severe austerities to marry विष्णु himself.) They were duly married.
Viṣṇu as Veṅkaṭeśvara settled down on the hill whereas his new consort had to stay back at the foot of the hill. This place now houses her temple and the place itself is called Tiruccānūr.
See तिरुपति">TIRUMALA-TIRUPATI for details.
